selection_reasons.reason: Full finite-area average illuminance definition relates received flux and area. Relevant to distinguishing luminous flux from illuminance and deriving the directional intensity relationship.
The lumen-to-lux unit relation anchors flux versus flux per area without touching the disputed historical standards.
Names the incident ray's direction, distance and intensity as the text-only factors in the source question.

The complete verbal definition specifies the angle between the incident ray and surface normal. Its Figure 135 cross-reference is illustrative: no coordinates or objects must be obtained from that figure to understand this sentence. The figure is not selected, copied, inspected or claimed reviewed.
The standalone point-source illuminance law states intensity, inverse-square distance and cosine dependence; it needs no diagram or worked example.

The author will record that distinction and derive intensity locally from the authorized relations.
